ACREntraAuthenticationAuditLog.operations_note: Read the service's own logging docs: cache-monitor-diagnostic-settings (diagnostic settings how-to), monitor-cache-reference (monitoring data reference), and the Azure Monitor column reference for ACREntraAuthenticationAuditLog. None enumerate OperationName/ActionName values for this table. The column reference describes OperationName only generically ('The Redis operation associated with the log record'). The diagnostic-settings page documents the 'MSEntra authentication audit log' category and shows sample JSON only for ConnectedClientList (BSP tier) and ConnectionEvents (Enterprise/REDConnectionEvents) categories -- no sample or value list for the Entra audit log. The Entra-related status strings AADAuthenticationFailure / MicrosoftEntraAuthenticationFailure / MicrosoftEntraTokenExpired in monitor-cache-reference describe the 'Connected Clients Using Microsoft Entra Token' metric, not this table's OperationName, so they are not reported here.
